name: inbox-intelligence
description: Personal Inbox Intelligence + Placement Operations system for action-oriented email triage, thread change detection, placement tracking, deadline extraction, and safe calendar planning.

interface.shortDescription: Turn email into actionable priorities, placement operations, deadlines, changes, and safe calendar plans.
interface.longDescription: Thread-aware inbox intelligence that preserves provider labels while adding analytical categories, evidence-based urgency, placement-stage tracking, assessment/interview/deadline extraction, thread change detection, calendar conflict detection, preparation planning, and human-approved external actions.
defaultPrompt: Find my urgent emails and explain why they are urgent.
Find upcoming assessments, interviews, deadlines, and schedule changes.
Create a calendar plan from my placement emails without making calendar changes.
